app_fee.value: The fee for doctoral courses is GBP 20 per applicant per academic year of entry, for up to 7 applications.
app_fee.quote: Doctoral courses (including combined MRes + PhD courses): £20 per applicant, per academic year of entry. You can submit up to a maximum of 7 applications.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic waivers apply only to nationals of a listed set of countries (India is not listed); other international applicants must pay.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants from other countries must pay the application fee.

also.quote: You do not need to pay an application fee if you are a national of an eligible country listed below and have lived there since birth.

gre_general.value: Set by each course; a course page says if it needs a GRE score.
gre_general.quote: Some departments may ask you for a Graduate Record Examination (GRE) test score.

toefl_min.value: Each course sets its own TOEFL level; see the program records.
toefl_min.quote: Check your course page for the scores required for your course.

ielts_min.value: Each course sets its own IELTS level; see the program records.
ielts_min.quote: Check your course page for the scores required for your course.

english_waiver.value: The test exemption is for nationals of, or degree-holders from, majority English-speaking countries; India is not on that list, so Indian applicants need a test.
english_waiver.quote: you are a national of a majority English-speaking country and were educated in such a country

also.quote: you have a 3-year qualification equivalent to at least a UK Bachelor's Degree from a majority English-speaking country, excluding Canada.

notes: English test is usually only needed once an offer is made.
